title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・伸び悩みの理由

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meisho Doto loses against T.M. Opera O. Air Shakur believes this is just one of many future consecutive losses.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It appears that Meisho Doto has yet to exceed Opera O's capabilities, let alone the previous generation's. The reason behind her stagnant rate of growth is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Her reverence for T.M. Opera O. She respects her idol too much, and it's causing her to hold back against her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she doesn't start seeing her idol as a rival, the future will remain bleak. She needs to realize this before our next race, the Japan Cup.
